content.title: Jaane se pehle
content.subtitle: Naye desh mein beemar padna sabse zyada pareshaan karta hai.

steps.title: Full checkup
steps.detail: Doctor, dentist aur aankhon ka checkup jaane se pehle. Wahan ye mehenga pad sakta hai.

steps.title: Dawai aur prescription
steps.detail: Regular dawai ka stock aur doctor ka prescription saath rakho. Rules pehle check karo.

steps.title: Insurance samjho
steps.detail: Policy mein kya cover hai aur kya nahi, ek baar padh lo. Claim kaise hota hai, ye bhi.
steps.tip: Fly & Settle pe travel aur health insurance ki help milti hai.

steps.title: Vaccination record
steps.detail: Saare records ek folder mein, scan karke bhi. University maang sakti hai.

steps.title: Emergency contacts
steps.detail: Local emergency number, university health centre aur ghar ka number. Phone mein bhi, likha hua bhi.

caption:
Flight se pehle health ki taiyari bhi zaroori hai. Ye 5 kaam karo 👇

1. Full checkup
2. Dawai aur prescription
3. Insurance samjho
4. Vaccination record
5. Emergency contacts

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
